description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

descriptions.zh: 必须先通过 ActivateVersionManagement 接口启用版本管理（站点 VersionManagement 状态为 true）。需要在仅有版本0与默认环境的情况下，才能关闭。
descriptions.en: Version management must be enabled through the ActivateVersionManagement operation (the site VersionManagement status is true). Version management can be disabled only when only version 0 and the default environment exist.
